jobs.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create a very high fidelity, photorealistic industrial product visualization board for INFINITY RING R3 IRIS. The supplied image is the APPROVED EXACT EXTERIOR IDENTITY, not a loose style reference. Retain the same sculpted continuous graphite titanium shoulders, fine directional brushed metal grain, compact recessed seven-blade optical iris, narrow finely diamond-knurled rotary bezel, two restrained interrupted emerald status arcs, small flush dark rounded rectangular front optical windows, and thin smoothly polished inner ring. Do NOT make the enlarged protruding watch-sized lid, giant camera rings, silver plastic or faceted cylinder seen in crude web models. Ring is naturally proportioned wearable jewelry, no gemstone, no superhero emblem.
Deliver a wide landscape luxury engineering art-direction plate split into two areas against matching nearly black studio backgrounds. Left 40%: a flawless assembled R3 in the identical three-quarter front-above angle of the reference, large and crisp, with brushed metal microtexture, precisely machined small bevels, black glass lenses with multiple subtle optical reflections and fine contact shadows at every seam. Right 60%: the same exact ring separated into 6 coherent functional subassemblies in an elegant compact exploded stack, readable with clear spacing. The hollow sculpted titanium housing and inner sleeve at bottom retain their proper ring silhouette. Above it, an appropriately small curved rigid-flex electronics carrier with dark IC packages, tiny actual-looking soldered SMD components, fine copper traces and amber flex ribbon; separate small dark curved power enclosure; tiny forward optical module pair aligned to the front housing apertures; above, the recessed seven overlapping iris blades in their mount; at top, the matching knurled annular bezel and two interrupted thin green light-guide arcs. Every exterior boundary must correspond to the assembled ring, consistent scale and camera, realistic materials. This is a concept functional decomposition, not manufacturing proof. No huge floating generic donuts, no loose wires or giant chips, no fantasy energy core. Use real macro product photography aesthetics / physically based path-traced CGI, white strip softboxes, black flags, realistic metal anisotropy, subtle edge glints, restrained green. No dramatic gaseous light beams. All component geometry in focus, crisp filmic contrast, premium camera engineering imagery. Small clean titles only 'ASSEMBLED' and 'FUNCTIONAL LAYERS'. No specifications, no dimensions, no other copy. 16:9 composition.

Use case: product-mockup. Use the supplied R3 IRIS product sheet as the exact original product identity. Create a 3 columns by 2 rows macro photography material-study board, six separate generous frames on a uniform near-black warm studio background with subtle hairline separators, wide 3:2 or 16:9 board. Each cell shows one DIFFERENT functional subassembly of the SAME ring at an appropriate macro scale, physically plausible visual surfaces and intricate small construction details. These are appearance studies of a concept, not a technical validated teardown.
Cell 1 '01 / TITANIUM': hollow sculpted R3 graphite titanium upper housing and smoothly narrowed ring body with the two flush front rounded rectangular optical apertures and a recessed crown opening. Real fine unidirectional brushing following curved shoulders, realistic wall thickness, subtle machining grooves inside, polished bevel transitions. Keep original silhouette.
Cell 2 '02 / ROTARY BEZEL': very thin annular circular dial with dense sharp diamond knurling on its side, fine chamfered edges, recessed black inner channel and two interrupted slender emerald light guides. Not a large thick gear or gemstone.
Cell 3 '03 / IRIS': macro recessed aperture assembly with SEVEN genuinely overlapping dark satin-metal leaves curling around one centered opening, visible thin thickness and very small pivot features, extremely fine material grain, precise mechanical aesthetic.
Cell 4 '04 / OPTICS': a small dual optical unit for the TWO original front windows, restrained square black lens barrels with visible concentric internal glass, violet-green antireflective coatings, miniature dark mount and tiny connection flex. No giant circular camera protrusions.
Cell 5 '05 / RIGID-FLEX': curved ring-compatible green rigid-flex board with dark matte tiny IC packages, solder menisci, resistors, gold connector pads, amber polyimide tail and fine realistic traces, not generic painted dots.
Cell 6 '06 / INNER SYSTEM': polished slim inner sleeve and separate small curved dark power enclosure with amber insulation edge, small gold contacts and sealed surface. No battery capacity, chemistry labels or fabricated technical measurements.
Photorealism is essential: physically based premium jewelry and camera product photography, layered studio reflections, contact shadows, high quality micro-surface material treatment. Consistent same softbox lighting and perspective across all frames, broad soft highlight and dark reflected flag. Green only where intentional light guides exist. Do not duplicate a complete ring in each cell, no cartoon, no low-poly, no overbloom. Minimal labels above exactly as specified, no body text. Make each part feel tangible, real and professional.

Use case: photorealistic-natural / product concept interaction. Use the supplied R3 IRIS image as exact wearable ring identity, maintain its graphite sculpted band, tiny flush front optical windows, recessed iris top and slim knurled rotary bezel. Create a professional cinematic THREE-FRAME storyboard in one wide landscape image, equal horizontal panels, showing the SAME hand and SAME tabletop electronics task from the SAME close side-above camera. Product visualization of a future interaction, not an existing tested device.
All 3 panels: realistic adult hand wearing the compact R3 on the index finger, pointing gently down toward a small connector on a detailed electronics board on a dark workbench. Ring sits on the finger at believable jewelry scale. Position hand on right half of each panel, target connector in lower-left half, both fully visible and in focus. A soft warm workbench lamp and controlled dark background, realistic skin pores and brushed metal.
Panel 1 label '01 / PROJECT': a very clear thin emerald elliptical boundary is projected ONTO the PCB surface surrounding a relatively broad group of components. Light follows the plane and is visibly occluded by raised components; tiny green bounce only on nearby surfaces. Small emerald emission seen in the forward optical aperture. Beam source direction connects logically to the target, but NO solid cone, NO floating hologram or airborne green circle.
Panel 2 label '02 / TURN': same fixed view, SAME hand/board identity. Opposite hand's thumb and fingertip visibly rotate the top knurled bezel, and projected ellipse is now MEDIUM sized centered on same connector. Show two faint dashed outline guides on the target plane as explanatory interface annotation only, hinting its adjustment from large to smaller. Most visible ring remains the physically projected medium green ellipse. The control action and projected outcome must be immediately understandable.
Panel 3 label '03 / FOCUS': opposite hand withdrawn, the bright crisp projected ellipse is now SMALL and precisely surrounds just the connector. Accurate perspective and occlusion. Light grazes connector edge and tiny pads, realistic localized green spill. Hand and R3 remain same design.
Make the optical action visually striking through composition and contrast, not unrealistically huge green fog. Product animation keyframe quality, high fidelity macro detail, dark premium industrial photography. No phone UI, no floating AI text, no altered ring design. The ring is not firing a weapon. White minimal panel labels only. 21:9 or 16:9 wide composition.

Edit the supplied premium ring assembly comparison image. Preserve the entire LEFT ASSEMBLED panel pixel-faithfully, and preserve all the original lighting, exact R3 shape, fine graphite brushed titanium texture, knurling, labels, exploded positions, materials and scale of the right panel. Make only one carefully localized correction in the right FUNCTIONAL LAYERS panel: the two rounded-rectangular optical windows in the separated BOTTOM TITANIUM HOUSING must be EMPTY DARK OPENINGS, revealing the empty interior cavity. Remove the lenses and any green reflections from these two housing openings only. The independent double-camera optical subassembly floating ABOVE the circuit board keeps its lenses and coatings intact. The detached module must not appear duplicated inside the bottom shell. The two holes should show appropriate thin machined wall and beveled aperture edges, shadowed inner cavity and no glass. Do not add or remove other subassemblies. Do not change composition. This is a concept visual correction, not a technical specification.

Reference 1 is the EXACT R3 Iris product identity. Reference 2 is a storyboard to REVISE. Preserve the 3-panel photorealistic dark electronics-workbench storytelling, typography ('01 / PROJECT', '02 / TURN', '03 / FOCUS'), lighting, materials and progressive large→medium→small green targeting ellipse around the SAME connector. Correct the pose and source of light in ALL THREE panels so the physical line of sight makes sense.
Replace the fully extended pointing finger with a naturally loosely CURLED index finger, carrying the ring on its proximal segment. The entire hand is visibly lifted well above the tabletop, with its fingertip tucked DOWN and BACK under the hand, away from the optical path. The front of the R3 ring is clearly seen and faces diagonally toward the connector farther to the LEFT. The ring's front optical window has a tiny restrained emerald emitter glint. There must be an OPEN, UNOBSTRUCTED diagonal path from that optical window to the ring-shaped light on the PCB. Nothing intersects that optical line: not the finger, not the thumb, not a component. NO bright green glow on the fingertip and NO light seeming to originate at the fingertip. The fingers are not touching the circuit board.
Panel 1: projected fine emerald ellipse wide around several PCB components.
Panel 2: other hand's thumb and fingertip touch ONLY the top knurled rotary bezel; avoid blocking the front windows; projected ellipse is medium. One subtle curved rotation-arrow overlay around top control is acceptable as an instructional diagram mark.
Panel 3: opposite hand withdrawn, projected ellipse tight around the connector, hand still curled and raised.
Light is a surface-bound thin line accurately following PCB perspective. It is interrupted by physical occlusion and produces tiny local bounce on adjacent component edges. No volumetric laser shaft, floating hologram or giant neon fog. Keep the R3 at wearable compact scale with correctly detailed recessed iris, flush dual optical windows, brushed titanium shoulders, restrained green status arcs. Re-render hands naturally with correct anatomy. Very high quality professional photoreal product scene, realistic macro textures, coherent board and hand across 3 frames. It illustrates a future concept interaction, not proven hardware. Wide composition.
